description: Worksman Cycles is excited to launch our newest product.... The Bike Chair™! The Bike Chair™ A Front-Passenger Electric Tricycle Designed for Safe, Shared Adventures The Bike Chair™ is a thoughtfully engineered front-passenger electric tricycle that transforms everyday rides into meaningful shared experiences. Designed by Worksman Cycles and imported with safety, comfort, and joy in mind, it allows an adult passenger to sit securely in front while a caretaker or rider pedals and steers from the rear. Perfect for caregivers, families, and care facilities, The Bike Chair™ offers a fun and engaging way to enjoy the outdoors together—bringing fresh air, movement, and stimulation to passengers who may otherwise have limited mobility or independence. Designed for Safety & Confidence Adult-Sized Front Passenger Full Size Chair – Stable, comfortable, and built specifically for adult passengers Rear Driver Control – The rider in back maintains full control of steering, braking, and speed Automotive-Style Front Steering System – Smooth, predictable handling for maximum stability Powerful Disc Brakes – Reliable stopping power for peace of mind Electric Assist – Makes every ride easier, even on longer outings or gentle hills UL-Approved Battery – Tested and certified for safety and reliability More Than a Ride — It’s an Experience The Bike Chair™ is ideal for adults with cognitive challenges, mobility limitations, or sensory needs. Riding up front encourages connection, conversation, and engagement with the world, while the caretaker enjoys a comfortable and intuitive riding experience. Whether it’s a neighborhood cruise, a park path, or a daily routine, The Bike Chair™ turns transportation into a moment of joy—for both the passenger and the driver. Safe. Engaging. Unforgettable. That’s The Bike Chair™.
